title: •Yoda, Senior Council Member
caption: •Yoda, Senior Council Member (V)
game_text: Deploys only to {episode1} sites. While at Jedi Council Chamber, immune to attrition, Jedi are deploy -2 here, and (unless a Dark Jedi here) other Jedi may treat “Jedi Council Chamber” in their game text as “{episode1} battleground sites.”
lore: Senior *Jedi Council member*. Responsible for the early training of Obi-Wan Kenobi. When Qui-Gon brought Anakin before the Council, Yoda voted not to train the boy.
